## Overview

In addition to the standard coursework, CEVE 521 students will **lead one Wednesday Paper Discussion session.**

You will not simply present a paper; you will design an active learning experience.

## Requirements

1. **Curate:** Select a relevant paper and set pre-reading questions.
2. **Design:** Create a lesson plan with at least one interactive element (e.g., Think-Pair-Share, Concept Map).
3. **Lead:** Facilitate the 50-minute discussion.

## Timeline

You must meet with the instructor **2 weeks prior** to your session to approve your plan.

## Deliverables

- Pre-reading questions (posted 1 week before your session)
- Lesson plan (submitted 2 weeks before for approval)
- Facilitation of the 50-minute discussion
